prompt: Select the two correct statements about this `httpd.conf` excerpt: `<Directory /var/web/dir1> <Files private.html> Order allow,deny; Deny from all </Files> </Directory>`
choices: It denies access to `private.html` in `/var/web/dir1` and any of its subdirectories
It only allows access to `private.html` in `/var/web/dir1`
It allows any file called `private.html` in `/var/web/dir1` but denies any other file
It allows access to `/var/web/private.html` if it exists
explanation: `<Files>` matches by basename throughout the directory and its subdirectories, so every `private.html` under `/var/web/dir1` is denied; `/var/web/private.html` lies outside that directory and is unaffected.
